[cite: 233] Do-It-Yourself: Tie-Dye T-shirt [cite: 234] Making your own tie-dye T-shirt is a fun activity that [cite: 235] allows you to be creative with colors. [cite: 236] Materials: [cite: 237] • A plain white cotton T-shirt [cite: 238] • Fabric dyes [cite: 239] • Rubber bands [cite: 240] • A plastic bag [cite: 241] • Rubber gloves [cite: 242] Steps: [cite: 243] 1. Wash the T-shirt but do not dry it. It must be damp before you start. [cite: 244] 2. Pinch the center of the shirt and twist it until it forms a flat, circular shape. [cite: 245] 3. Wrap rubber bands tightly around the folded [cite: 246] shirt to hold its shape. [cite: 247] 4. Put on rubber gloves to protect your hands. [cite: 248] 5. Squeeze different colors of fabric dye onto [cite: 249] different sections of the shirt. [cite: 250] 6. Place the dyed shirt into a plastic bag to keep it damp. Let it sit for 24 hours. [cite: 251] Do not leave the plastic bag in direct sunlight because it will dry out the shirt too fast. [cite: 252] 7. After 24 hours, take the shirt out and remove the rubber bands. [cite: 253] 8. Rinse the shirt under cold water until the water runs clear. [cite: 254] 9. Dry the T-shirt and it is ready to wear. [cite: 255]
